html:
The Second Nagorno Karabakh War was a 44 day war in autumn 2020 in which Azerbaijan, backed by Turkey, retook most of the territory it had lost to Armenian forces in the first war.

Azerbaijan's drones, many from Turkey and Israel, destroyed Armenian tanks and artillery, and its troops advanced through the southern districts to take Shusha on 8 November. Two days later a Russian brokered ceasefire left the rest of Karabakh to its Armenian administration under Russian peacekeepers. About 7,000 soldiers died. In September 2023 Azerbaijan took the remaining territory in a one day offensive, after which almost all of Karabakh's Armenians fled, in the flight of 2023. The war reshaped the balance of the Caucasus.
sum: The Second Nagorno Karabakh War was a 44 day war in autumn 2020 in which Azerbaijan, backed by Turkey, retook most of the territory it had lost to Armenian forces in the first war.
